Explore how price, horsepower, and highway fuel economy compare across vehicle
types. Hover over points and bars for vehicle details.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(plotly))

cars <- read_csv(
  "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/dvinubius/33486dad2dc86319f0a06ffdb1d4f34f/raw/",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  drop_na(
    Make, Model, Year, MSRP, `Engine HP`, `highway MPG`,
    `Vehicle Size`, `Vehicle Style`
  ) |>
  filter(MSRP > 0, `Engine HP` > 0, `highway MPG` > 0)

car_rows <- cars |>
  transmute(
    Make,
    Model,
    Year,
    price = MSRP,
    horsepower = `Engine HP`,
    highway_mpg = as.numeric(`highway MPG`),
    vehicle_size = `Vehicle Size`,
    vehicle_type = `Vehicle Style`,
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<b>", Make, " ", Model, " (", Year, ")</b>",
      "<br>Price: ", scales::dollar(MSRP, accuracy = 1),
      "<br>Horsepower: ", `Engine HP`, " hp",
      "<br>Highway fuel economy: ", highway_mpg, " MPG",
      "<br>Vehicle type: ", `Vehicle Style`,
      "<br>Vehicle size: ", `Vehicle Size`
    )
  )
```

## Price vs. Horsepower

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = car_rows,
  x = ~price,
  y = ~horsepower,
  color = ~vehicle_size,
  colors = c("#2A9D8F", "#E76F51", "#457B9D"),
  text = ~hover_label,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.6)
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Price (MSRP)", tickformat = "$,.0f"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Engine horsepower (hp)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Vehicle size")),
    hovermode = "closest"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE)
```

## Horsepower vs. Highway MPG

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = car_rows,
  x = ~highway_mpg,
  y = ~horsepower,
  color = ~vehicle_size,
  colors = c("#2A9D8F", "#E76F51", "#457B9D"),
  text = ~hover_label,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.6)
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Highway fuel economy (MPG)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Engine horsepower (hp)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Vehicle size")),
    hovermode = "closest"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE)
```

## Average Highway MPG by Vehicle Type

```{r}
mpg_by_type <- car_rows |>
  group_by(vehicle_type) |>
  summarise(
    average_highway_mpg = mean(highway_mpg),
    vehicles = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(average_highway_mpg) |>
  mutate(
    vehicle_type = factor(vehicle_type, levels = vehicle_type),
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<b>", vehicle_type, "</b>",
      "<br>Average highway MPG: ", round(average_highway_mpg, 1),
      "<br>Vehicles: ", vehicles
    )
  )

plot_ly(
  data = mpg_by_type,
  x = ~average_highway_mpg,
  y = ~vehicle_type,
  text = ~hover_label,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  marker = list(color = "#2A9D8F")
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Average highway fuel economy (MPG)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Vehicle type"),
    margin = list(l = 150)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE)
```

## Automotive Trends Dashboard

Explore average highway fuel economy and horsepower over time, then compare
manufacturer averages. Use the filters to focus every chart on selected
manufacturers, vehicle types, and model years. The dashboard reads the local
project dataset in `data/cars_msrp_kaggle.csv`; its MPG values are from that
dataset and are not EPA-certified ratings.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(crosstalk))

cars_dashboard <- read_csv(
  "data/cars_msrp_kaggle.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  transmute(
    Make = str_trim(Make),
    Model = str_trim(Model),
    Year = parse_integer(as.character(Year)),
    horsepower = parse_number(as.character(`Engine HP`)),
    highway_mpg = parse_number(as.character(`highway MPG`)),
    vehicle_type = str_trim(`Vehicle Style`)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Make), Make != "",
    !is.na(Model), Model != "",
    !is.na(Year),
    !is.na(horsepower), horsepower > 0,
    !is.na(highway_mpg), highway_mpg > 0,
    !is.na(vehicle_type), vehicle_type != ""
  )

trend_data <- cars_dashboard |>
  group_by(Make, vehicle_type, Year) |>
  summarise(
    average_mpg = mean(highway_mpg),
    average_horsepower = mean(horsepower),
    vehicles = n(),
    sample_models = paste(head(sort(unique(Model)), 3), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<b>", Make, "</b> - ", vehicle_type, " - ", Year,
      "<br>Average highway MPG: ",
      format(average_mpg, digits = 10, trim = TRUE),
      "<br>Average horsepower: ",
      format(average_horsepower, digits = 10, trim = TRUE), " hp",
      "<br>Vehicles in average: ", vehicles,
      "<br>Example models: ", sample_models
    )
  )

trend_shared <- SharedData$new(
  trend_data,
  key = ~interaction(Make, vehicle_type, Year, drop = TRUE),
  group = "automotive-trends"
)
```

::: {.dashboard-filters}
Choose one or more manufacturers and vehicle types, or narrow the model-year
range. The same selections apply to all three charts.

```{r}
bscols(
  widths = c(4, 4, 4),
  filter_select(
    "trend_manufacturer",
    "Manufacturer",
    trend_shared,
    ~Make,
    multiple = TRUE
  ),
  filter_select(
    "trend_vehicle_type",
    "Vehicle type",
    trend_shared,
    ~vehicle_type,
    multiple = TRUE
  ),
  filter_slider(
    "trend_model_year",
    "Model year",
    trend_shared,
    ~Year,
    step = 1
  )
)
```
:::

### Average highway MPG by model year

Each line represents a manufacturer and vehicle-type combination. Hover for
the exact group average, sample size, horsepower, and example models.

```{r}
mpg_trend <- ggplot(
  trend_shared,
  aes(
    x = Year,
    y = average_mpg,
    color = vehicle_type,
    group = interaction(Make, vehicle_type),
    text = hover_label
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    x = "Model year",
    y = "Average highway MPG",
    color = "Vehicle type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggplotly(mpg_trend, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(hovermode = "closest") |>
  config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE)
```

### Average horsepower by model year

```{r}
horsepower_trend <- ggplot(
  trend_shared,
  aes(
    x = Year,
    y = average_horsepower,
    color = vehicle_type,
    group = interaction(Make, vehicle_type),
    text = hover_label
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    x = "Model year",
    y = "Average horsepower (hp)",
    color = "Vehicle type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggplotly(horsepower_trend, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(hovermode = "closest") |>
  config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE)
```

### Average highway MPG by manufacturer

Dots show average MPG for each manufacturer, vehicle type, and model year in
the selected range. Hover to compare the group average and the number of
vehicles behind it.

```{r}
manufacturer_mpg <- ggplot(
  trend_shared,
  aes(
    x = average_mpg,
    y = Make,
    color = vehicle_type,
    size = vehicles,
    text = hover_label
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.12, width = 0)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Average highway MPG",
    y = "Manufacturer",
    color = "Vehicle type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggplotly(manufacturer_mpg, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(hovermode = "closest") |>
  config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE)
```
